messages:
Morgan: Quick proposal a tiny remediation/handoff flow to stop postmortem drift. sketch below, feedback welcome.

Alex: Short + actionable templates are ideal. Can we auto-create a canonical GH issue or Notion page from day 0? saves duplication. :+1:  

Priya: Yes. Also want a small set of recurrence tags (kv-cache, routing, auth, infra-config, network) so we can roll up trends later.

Chris: Minimal template I hacked for the spike: 
```
- owner: @alex
- due: 2026-05-01
- summary: batch-size bump -> M60 OOMs at peak
- mitigation: revert batch to 32 on canary, monitor oom_count
- rollout: canary -> 25% -> 100% (manual checks)
- watch: oom_count, p95_latency
- tags: kv-cache,memory-pressure
- status: open/in-progress/done
```

Sam: Two process rules: (1) owner assigned before PM closure; (2) bot reminders at 3d/7d/14d/30d, escalate to oncall lead if >72h unresponsive.

Taylor: IC rotation: 2-week primary IC, 1-week secondary shadow. Handoff checklist should include open actions (owner+due) and active mitigations.

Morgan: Proposed cadence: owner check-ins at 3d/7d/14d/30d. After 30d open items move to recurring-remediations board for prioritization. oncall-bot will post brief updates in the incident thread.

oncall-bot: Example commands:
/remediate create --owner @alex --due 2026-05-01 --tags kv-cache,memory-pressure --notify 3d,7d,14d,30d
/remediate escalate --owner @alex --to @oncall-lead --after 72h

Alex: I'll draft bot CLI mappings and GH/Notion sync this week.

Priya: I'll publish the tag taxonomy and a one-pager guide. include examples.

Chris: I'll prototype GH issue creation from the template; 30-min spike tomorrow. will post results here.

Sam: I'll run a first "remediation triage" next month to surface items >90d.

Morgan: If no objections I'll update the runbook with the mini-template and automation checklist. thanks all. :tada:

Alex: :thumbsup:

Priya: LGTM

Chris: sounds good

oncall-bot: Reminders scheduled: 3d,7d,14d,30d. GH issue creation enabled for infra-tagged items.
